paite: Pathian aw, hon hehpih in; mihing in hon valh khit atum uhi, nitum in hon sual in hon nuaisiah uh.
heading: David La / Pathian A Muanna Thumna Philistiate'n Gath Khua A Amat Lai Ua
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Silent Dove in Distant Lands.” A poem by David, when the Philistines seized him in Gath. Be merciful to me, God, for man wants to swallow me up. All day long, he attacks and oppresses me.

paite: Ka melmate'n nitum in hon valh zoh atum ua, kisatheitak a hon sualte lah atam ngal ua.
english: My enemies want to swallow me up all day long, for they are many who fight proudly against me.

paite: Ka lau chiang in, nangmah ka hon muang hi.
english: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.

paite: Pathian ah athu ka phat ding a; Pathian ka gingta a, ka lau kei ding; sa in bang ahon chih thei dia!
english: In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?

paite: Nitum in ka thute alakawi ua; angaihtuahna tengteng tuh ka siatna ding lam ngen ahi.
english: All day long they twist my words. All their thoughts are against me for evil.

paite: Akikhawm ua, abu ua, ka khapte achiamteh ua, ka hinna hihmang tum a angak ziak un.
english: They conspire and lurk, watching my steps. They are eager to take my life.

paite: Thulimlouhna in asuahtak san ding uam! Pathian aw, heh in michih hihniam in.
english: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, God.

paite: Nang ka vakvaihnate na chiamteh a, ka khituite na savun thawl ah thun in; na laibu ah atuang chiat kei ua hia!
english: You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your container. Aren’t they in your book?

paite: K'on sap hun ngeingei in hon doute ataizak ding ua; hiai ka thei, Pathian in hon panpih hi.
english: Then my enemies shall turn back in the day that I call. I know this: that God is for me.

paite: Pathian ah athu ka phat ding a, TOUPA ah athu ka phat ding hi.
english: In God, I will praise his word. In Yahweh, I will praise his word.

paite: Pathian ka gingta a, ka lau kei ding; mihing in bang ahon chih thei dia!
english: I have put my trust in God. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

paite: Pathian aw, na kiang ah thuchiam ka nei a, kipahthugen kikhopnate in ka hon thuk ding hi.
english: Your vows are on me, God. I will give thank offerings to you.

paite: Ka hinna sihna lak ah na humbit a; ka khete puk lou ding in na humbit kei a hia! Hinna vak a Pathian ma a ka paitheihna ding in.
english: For you have delivered my soul from death, and prevented my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living.
